d:
The Drop welcomes new PGA Tour winner Blades Brown to the show, fresh on the heels of his win at the World Wide Technology Championship. The first teenager to win on the PGA Tour since Jordan Spieth talks about overcoming a 7-shot deficit, what it means to be a winner on Tour and how strong the game’s future looks with all the great young players he’s competing with.
The DROP is a weekly show that highlights the PGA Tour lifestyle inside and outside the ropes, telling the unique stories of the game's top names, as well as the up-and-coming stars on Tour.
